title: اتساق الخطة والانحراف المرصود
rule:
Applies when: At meaningful progress boundaries and reviews.
Compare observed work with the approved goal, plan baseline, acceptance criteria and governing rules. Report measured populations, exclusions, unexamined scope and evidence-linked deviations by severity; distinguish approved replanning from unauthorized drift. Recommend corrective work without self-amending policy; critical failures are not averaged away.
rationale: إخفاء انحراف حرج بمتوسط قد يمنع تصحيح المسار. PROVISIONAL_OWNER_REVIEW
reviewCadence: Owner review before activation and after material changes
